statusSound.Name: Report Status Volume
statusSound.Description: Volume of the radio sound when triggering report status

enemyMarker.Name: Enemy Marker
enemyMarker.Description: Show enemy position when reporting status. If disabled, the enemy marker sound will also be disabled

squadSpawn.Name: Squad Spawn
squadSpawn.Description: Set the volume of the report status sound

squadSize.Name: Squad size
squadSize.Description: Number of followers to spawn with

extraPickups.Name: Maximum pickup followers
extraPickups.Description: Maximum followers the player can pick up during a raid. This is in addition to the squad

returnChanceDeath.Name: Squadmate return chance after death
returnChanceDeath.Description: Chance your followers will return the items you gave them should you die. This applies only to members you spawned with

squadSetup.Name: Use Squad setup
squadSetup.Description: Use specific setup for your squad

scanDistance.Name: Maximum scan distance
scanDistance.Description: Maximum distance to pick up any visible enemy that the player is signaling when issuing 'Contact' phrase

patrolRadius.Name: Patrol Radius
patrolRadius.Description: Maximum distance from the player the followers will patrol around

enemyRemember.Name: Time to forget about the enemy (in sec.)
enemyRemember.Description: Maximum time a follower will remember an enemy. This is applied only at the beginning of a raid

healthMultiplier.Name: Squad Health Multiplier
healthMultiplier.Description: Health multiplier for the followers you spawn with. This is applied per each body part.

memberTactic.Name: Squad Member {0} Tactic
memberTactic.Description: Set Squad member fight tactic. Default is a combination of Pusher and Holder. Pusher tries to push the enemy often. Holder will stay in place around the boss. Marksman will try to get a position from where he can shoot preferably from behind the player, at a distance and will not push even if ordered. Support will provide frequent suppression fire and is able to use grenades and the grenade launcher as secondary weapon

memberEquipment.Name: Squad Member {0} Equipment
memberEquipment.Description: Set Squad member equipment. You can choose between default (which is SPT random equipment), user's current equipment or user created presets (recommended if using a tactic different than default)

memberName.Name: Squad Member {0} Nickname
memberName.Description: Set a custom nickname for this Squad member. Leave blank for default

memberUniformTop.Name: Squad Member {0} Top
memberUniformTop.Description: Set what the top clothes for this member should be. Leave blank for default

memberUniformBottom.Name: Squad Member {0} Bottom
memberUniformBottom.Description: Set what the pants for this member should be. Leave blank for default

equipmentLock.Name: Lock Squad Equipment
equipmentLock.Description: Locks the equipment of the squad members. This is useful if you want to use your own equipment presets and do not wish to lose the equipment if you or them die. Consumables are excluded.

npcSendMessage.Name: Raid End Messages
npcSendMessage.Description: Followers will send message at the end of the raid based on conditions such as if all made it out or if you picked up a follower and kept him alive. Return items messages are excluded

friendlyPMC.Name: Friendly PMC Side
friendlyPMC.Description: Should PMC Bots of the same side always be friendly to each other

badGuy.Name: Bad Guy
badGuy.Description: Should the player be hostile to all PMC bots, regardless of faction

pmcArmbands.Name: PMC Arm Bands
pmcArmbands.Description: Should PMC bots have armbands (red for BEARs, blue for USECs)

englishBear.Name: BEARs speak English
englishBear.Description: Should BEAR bots speak English or Russian

pingSquad.Name: Ping Squad
pingSquad.Description: Shortcut key for triggering the Report call

enemyContact.Name: Enemy Report
enemyContact.Description: Shortcut key for triggering the Contact call

botTeleport.Name: Followers Teleport
botTeleport.Description: Teleport all followers to the player's position

botHeal.Name: Followers Heal
botHeal.Description: Heal all followers. This also get's them out of the healing animation or grenade throwing animation

botPrefetch.Name: Prefetch follower data
botPrefetch.Description: Prefetch follower data to reduce the time it takes to spawn them. Disable this if you have conflicts with other mods
